open_questions: Failed-login 401 code: 00 does not restate it; FR-FLOW-004 AC-2 uses invalid_credentials (05 INVALID_CREDENTIALS lower-cased by the R30 code rule) tagged [INFERRED:med:advisory].
Refresh failure 401 code: FR-FLOW-005 AC-4 uses invalid_refresh_token (05) tagged [INFERRED:med:advisory]; 00 only says '401'.
Wrong current password on POST /auth/password: SEC-FLOW-014 AC-2 uses 403 current_password_invalid from 05 [INFERRED]; 00 does not restate it.

PATCH /auth/me with a non-allowed attribute: 05 says 422 ATTRIBUTE_NOT_ALLOWED, 00 R30 puts auth input checks under 400 BAD_REQUEST; FR-FLOW-006 AC-3 fixes only 'rejected, unchanged'. PATCH /auth/me success status 200 is from 05 [INFERRED].
CSRF token HMAC key derivation is not specified in 00 (device tokens use HMAC(secret,'naru-device')); token string format base64url(random16).HMAC is from 05 [INFERRED].
naru_device cookie attributes (Path, HttpOnly, SameSite, Max-Age) are not given in 00 or 05; other cookie defaults (HttpOnly/SameSite/Path/Max-Age/Secure) are from 05 only [INFERRED].
DeviceTrust SPI method signatures are not specified in 00 or 05.

Lockout: response status/code for a locked account, policy parameters and builder shape (07 proposes .lockout(Lockout.after(5).forMinutes(15)), tagged INFERRED, name not final), and success status of DELETE /auth/admin/users/:id/lockout are not given.
Builder method names for login-throttle limits ('수치는 빌더로 바꾼다', R34 (1)) are not named.
allowInsecureTransport: handling of null/empty reason and how often the 'cookies without Secure' warning is logged are not specified.
Whether the JWT 403 insufficient_scope challenge also carries scope="<s>" (05 §4.0) is not restated by 00.
Cache-Control: no-store on token responses comes from 05 only [INFERRED].
Response status when POST /auth/register is disabled (404 vs other) is not specified; ACs only assert no user and not 201.
Browser WebSocket token transport recommendation (cookie mode vs Sec-WebSocket-Protocol) is open per 00 §10 Q3.
LoginThrottle return-value semantics (0 allow, positive ms) are from 05 §3.9 [INFERRED].

Ownership: inventory items 'Admin user and group endpoints' and 'Admin PATCH A4 application order' sit in the FLOW area but the assignment gives admin endpoints to IAM; FLOW did not write them. Main session should confirm IAM covers A1-A6/G1-G8 + A4 order + DELETE lockout route table.
